propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Excita, quaesumus, Domine, in Ecclesia tua Spiritum, quo repletus beatus
Josaphat Martyr et Pontifex tuus animam suam pro ovibus posuit: ut, eo
intercedente, nos quoque eodem Spiritu moti ac roborati, animam nostram pro
fratribus ponere non vereamur. Per Dominum ... in unitate ejusdem Spiritus
Sancti.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Clementissime Deus, munera haec tua benedictione perfunde, et nos in fide
confirma: quam sanctus Josaphat Martyr et Pontifex tuus, effuso sanguine,
asseruit. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.
